body: BUG-619 (Draft) flagged for advisor disposition. Symptom: aida tui lags navigating to the PRs panel; the cursor/selection is delayed on each move into the panel. Root cause (code-grounded): dashboard.rs:210 routes NavSection::Prs to fetch_prs() synchronously per navigation, and fetch_prs() (dashboard.rs:328) shells out to gh pr list on the UI thread. Desired: async-load on launch + periodic/on-command refresh (not per-navigation); navigate immediately and show a refreshing notice with last-known rows; never block the cursor. Building blocks already exist (notice-line slot dashboard.rs:130; spawn_overlay_refresh precedent app.rs:1139; graceful gh-unavailable degrade in welcome.rs). Has acceptance criteria. Recommend: approve + queue for implementer. Medium priority; tags tui/performance/papercut/ux. Filed by the product seat.
